summary: I read all 14 room pages for frontmatter and the passages that touch the ten weak links, plus the ten targets (Oblique Portrait, README, Spore Check, GEMMA4_GUIDE, SUBSTRATE, Agent Wellbeing, Palace Ceremonies) and the newcomers CHILD, Operator Memory and SCHEMA — Reference. Six of the ten links have a reason somewhere and take a label (Creative Coach to Oblique Portrait, Deposit to README, Entry Conatus to Spore Check, JEWEL to SUBSTRATE, Lateral Access to Creative Coach, Mermaid to README); one is really membership (Return Ceremony to Palace Ceremonies, member-of, and the hub's own connects-to back should go); three have no reason and are cut (Palace Conatus to Agent Wellbeing, Palace To-Do to README, and Gemma 4 guide to GEMMA4_GUIDE, which is a duplicate of the guide's own child-of link). The pattern: the reason often sits on the target or on the other side's page, not on the source. Two member pairs carry doubled links (Identity Molting and Creative Coach; Identity Molting and Lateral Access), flagged as retypes. Newcomer inbounds proposed only where a page already cites them: Deposit and Revival to SCHEMA — Reference, Palace To-Do to CAD Drafter. I did not propose Palace as Context Injection System to CHILD, because CHILD already links it. Could not settle: whether JEWEL to SUBSTRATE and Lateral Access to Creative Coach deserve their labels given the reason is stated on only one side; whether Gemma entry or guide should keep the surviving link; Identity Molting's stage (read only its headings).
